# Haider Khursheed

> Founder and entrepreneur building consumer companies and AI-first software at the intersection of media and technology. Co-founder of Lixta Network and Home for Builders.

## Core Information
- **Name**: Haider Khursheed
- **Role**: Founder, CEO & Entrepreneur
- **Primary Ventures**: 
  - **Lixta Network** (Co-founder & CEO): Creative studio & venture foundry turning manual workflows into AI-first software and enterprise solutions. (URL: https://lixtanetwork.com)
  - **Home for Builders** (Founder): Execution-first ecosystem & startup school for developers, designers, and internet builders. (URL: https://homeforbuilders.com)
  - **Aeomi** (Founder): Frontier AI research lab focusing on persistent cognitive memory systems. (URL: https://aeomi.me)
  - **Komunity** (Co-founder): Onchain hiring platform based on proof of work (Pre-seed funded at ₹12.9M valuation; acquired valuable PMF lessons). (URL: https://komunity.dev)
  - **Game Development Studio** (Founder): Founded at age 16, scaled globally, acquired by a game publisher in mid-2024.
- **Website**: https://www.haiderkhursheed.com
- **Contact**: haider@lixtanetwork.com / haiderkhursheedk@gmail.com

## Featured Essays & Writing
- [The Art of Dreaming Delusionally Big](https://www.haiderkhursheed.com/writing/the-art-of-dreaming-delusionally-big): On audacity, vision, and building without artificial limits.
- [Cognitive Memory Systems in AI](https://www.haiderkhursheed.com/writing/cognitive-memory-systems-in-ai): Architecture and implications of persistent memory in autonomous AI agents.
- [Building in Public and the Art of Shipping](https://www.haiderkhursheed.com/writing/building-in-public-and-the-art-of-shipping): Why rapid execution beats theoretical planning.
- [What Failing Taught Me About Product Distribution](https://www.haiderkhursheed.com/writing/what-failing-taught-me-about-product-distribution): Hard-learned lessons from scaling Komunity before nailing distribution.
